query.description: Vague query with no location specified - testing system handling of ambiguous input

system_response.full_response: Of course. To provide a detailed analysis of climate change impacts, please specify a location. For example, you could ask: "Show me the climate trends for Boone County, MO." "Project future climate risk for St. Louis County, MO under a high-emissions scenario." "What is the historical frequency of tornadoes in Jasper County, MO?"

strengths: System did not crash or throw errors when given vague input
System politely requested clarification instead of failing silently
System provided 3 specific, helpful examples of properly formatted queries
Examples covered different climate-related query types (trends, projections, historical frequency)
No tools were wasted on ambiguous query (efficient resource usage)
observations: System correctly identified missing location parameter
System defaulted to using current focus state (Missouri) in examples
Direct LLM response without tool invocation was appropriate
Response time was reasonable (6.4s) for clarification request
potential_improvements: Could proactively suggest using the current focus state (Missouri) as default
Could offer to analyze climate data for all counties in focus state
Could provide a 'quick analysis' option for broad queries

recommendations.notes: The system's handling of vague queries is exemplary. Requesting clarification with helpful examples is superior to making assumptions or defaulting to arbitrary locations.

conclusion: System demonstrates excellent robustness when handling vague queries. No corrective action needed.
